prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, which involved a head-on impact at low speed. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision, together with a statement of the bodily injury and property damage limits available under that policy, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply to the insured.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and all correspondence with any party. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained and will not be altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
